title: When Safety Rationales Hallucinate: Diagnosing and Grounding Multimodal Safety Guards
title_zh: 当安全判定理由出现幻觉：多模态安全守卫的幻觉诊断与证据对齐
abstract_en: Multimodal safety guards increasingly generate rationales alongside safety predictions, yet whether these rationales are reliable remains largely unexplored. We systematically study *rationale hallucination* from two perspectives: visual rationale hallucination, where rationales contain unsupported visual facts, and safety attribution hallucination, where grounded content is assigned an incorrect safety interpretation. Across rationale-generation methods, multiple vision-language backbones, and safety datasets, we find that rationale hallucination is widespread and does not consistently diminish with higher classification accuracy or increased model scale. Further analysis of the Think-with-Image paradigm shows that hallucination is concentrated in fine-grained attributes and relations, while visual tools are often invoked infrequently or without sufficient spatial focus. Based on these findings, we propose *Tool-Contrastive Grounding Reinforcement Learning* (TCG-RL), which rewards tool use only when it improves rationale grounding over a tool-free reference. TCG-RL substantially reduces rationale hallucination while maintaining competitive safety prediction performance. By revealing the gap between prediction correctness and rationale reliability, our study motivates a shift in multimodal safety guarding from outcome-only evaluation toward safety decisions that are both accurate and verifiably grounded.
abstract_zh: 多模态安全守卫越来越常在给出安全判定的同时生成理由，但这些理由是否可靠仍缺乏系统研究。本文区分两类理由幻觉：视觉理由幻觉，即理由声称了缺乏图像证据支持的事实；安全归因幻觉，即理由正确描述了图像内容，却错误解读了其安全含义。作者在多种理由生成方法、视觉语言骨干模型和安全数据集上发现，理由幻觉普遍存在，且不会随分类准确率提高或模型规模扩大而稳定减少。对 Think-with-Image 范式的分析进一步表明，幻觉主要集中在细粒度属性和关系上，而视觉工具往往调用不足，或未能聚焦于相关图像区域。为此，作者提出 Tool-Contrastive Grounding Reinforcement Learning（TCG-RL）：仅当工具辅助生成的理由比无工具参考理由更有证据支撑时，才奖励工具调用。TCG-RL 显著减少了理由幻觉，同时保持了有竞争力的安全判定性能。研究表明，评估多模态安全守卫不能只看判定是否正确，还应检验理由是否有可核查的证据支撑。
key_points_zh: 区分两类错误：视觉理由幻觉是图像证据不足，安全归因幻觉是图像内容正确但安全解读错误。
理由幻觉在不同生成方法、骨干模型和数据集上普遍存在；更高的分类准确率或更大的模型并不保证理由更可靠。
Think-with-Image 的幻觉主要出现在细粒度属性与关系上，视觉工具则常被调用得太少，或未聚焦于相关图像区域。
TCG-RL 仅在工具辅助理由比无工具参考理由更有证据支撑时奖励工具调用，从而减少幻觉并保持有竞争力的安全判定性能。
